value.rationale: The balanced equality Gamma=Delta=c in Willox’s recently derived predator-prey recurrence is a naturally selected parameter boundary, and Z^2 is its natural integer cellular-automaton state space. Classification of all initial conditions on an infinite state space, all primitive periods including a plateau beyond c=4, and an exactly quadratic transient family are structural dynamical results not implied by showing one short orbit. No claims extend to rational states, global Euclidean attraction or arbitrary parameter pairs.
